title: The headless session driver runs under evals/replay and the pilot uses it
body:
Split of S24 (t-x4z168s), step 1 of 3. Recon 2026-11-17: `krn lane run` is the only unattended path for outside-repo pilots (.krn/runs/pilot/lanes/run.sh, doctor-unattended, outside-acceptance), and the binding overnight goal ranks "KRN delivers tasks in an outside repository unattended" first, so the session driver must move before anything is deleted. evals/replay/run.ts without --dry exits 69 "live sessions need the session driver (lane run)".
Outcome: the headless session driver (src/cli/lane-run/session.ts with the prepare/result/verdict pieces it needs) lives under evals/replay; `node evals/replay/run.ts --arms C --units 1` runs one live row and prints a verdict line; the pilot lane script runs through the same driver; `krn lane run` delegates to it until step 3 removes the verb.
Proof: `node evals/replay/run.ts --arms C --units 1` prints `verdict:`; the pilot lane script still delivers one task in an outside test repo.
